notes.title: Gatlin' - The Delightful Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31717521/c292e9c3ccdd5e945fa639efc81a92d2b35b19eb.png[/img]
[h1]Gatlin' - The Delightful Update (V1.2.0)[/h1]
[i]Additional eye candy for your neverquenching eyes.[/i]

[h2]Introducing... death!![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31717521/e7e46f26a6458a0468469565a04277c800a31c83.gif[/img]
A wise man once said, "DUDE, I just spent 84 minutes on this GODFORSAKEN boss fight. Why did it just END? Why couldn't I see the boss SUFFER as it faded away into the ETERNAL abyss we all slowly march towards? I DESERVE that much, I GAVE you $4.99."

I'm not your therapist, in fact, I'm probably the opposite of one with what I offer you. Anyhoo - sure! All bosses now have some form of death animation. Now go feel accomplished, sport. Pop off. Slay. 💅🌟

[h2]Moisten your eyes![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31717521/cbde1cdc715ea8aa78107462e9efaced56867e06.gif[/img]
A second wise man, no relation, once said, "DUDE, why do I have to fight The Beholder EVERY time I battle Art? What is WRONG with you? Seriously, I'm earnestly asking. How do you sleep at night?"

Still not your therapist, nor are you mine - keep that Gatlin-related trauma to yourself. Anyhoo - OK! Blot's childhood friend found eyedrops. If you can find him and collect the eyedrops, you can easily cast off The Beholder. The average monthly 0 players of Gatlin' PLEASE cry out in joy! 👏👏👏

[h2]A new level modifier - One Life![/h2]
I nerfed the Beholder. I nerfed Art. Do you still want a challenge? This level modifier, with an accompanying achievement, gives you the gift of playing through the entire main game with one life. If you die, you start over at the first level. How generous! How replayable!

[h2]A new level modifier - John Gatlin![/h2]
Continuing my streak of philanthropy, have another challenge. In the "John Gatlin" level modifier, you only get standard ammo and must run the entire main game for achievement or self-loathing purposes. No blitz, no pogos, and no suction. As a silver lining, I've replaced all boulders with poppable balloons. How quaint! I am nothing if not benevolent.

[h2]Painstakingly Godawful Achievements![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31717521/f394b5de14dafbe12641de02559f0bb635db4e04.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31717521/10b4ef868ac401469c2c21e96b59f123b7dbdeec.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31717521/381c606b08389adf495ca95127d9833094f0c67d.png[/img]
Three new achievements. One for finding the eyedrops and two for beating the game with the new level modifiers. You want to earn 100% of Gatlin's achievements? Nah.

[h1]Update Log[/h1]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Added eyedrops (oh, and I guess Blot's childhood friend) to a non-specified level[/b]
[*] [b]Added two new level modifiers ("One Life" + "John Gatlin")[/b]
[*] [b]Added three new achievements ("Dropped", "Get One", "John Gatlin' Is Real and He's You")[/b]
[*] [b]Added death animations for David, The Protector, Apprencii, Art, Credits, and Damn[/b]
[*] Added various idle animations to David
[*] Art now has a unique allergy... to standard bullets (what a trope reversal!)
[*] Lowered the number of targets required for the "Target Practice" achievement from 1000 to 500
[*] Lowered the number of Knight kills required for the "Midknight Crisis" achievement from 250 to 50
[/list]
[h2]Fixes + Performance[/h2]
[list]
[*] Actually fixed the lighting for Blot's corpse
[*] The Protector no longer sometimes shakes Scribbles from the wrong armpit
[*] The Protector no longer has a random floating torso piece during its tank attack
[*] Apprencii no longer hides Blot's corpse if you die in front of him
[*] Art no longer randomly waits for you to attack her before moving
[*] Optimized code logic for David, The Protector, The Beholder, Art, and Credits
[*] Optimized code logic for the "Note" and "Camera" enemies
[*] Remapped controller navigation for the pause menu to be more intuitive
[*] Upgraded to a newer engine version
[*] Upgraded lighting tech to a non-experimental version
[*] Removed unused libraries to improve performance
[/list]

notes.title: Gatlin' - The Easy Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31717521/78a6b0b1cd7c54d41da140ae9235126b5eb9a229.png[/img]
[h1]Gatlin' - The Easy Update (V1.1.0)[/h1]
[i]More content, more QoL, less throwing your keyboard against the wall. Guaranteed.[/i]

[h2]Introducing... Easy Mode![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31717521/f3849b22a43e04d1a76623ee7a5e6b100f4f80a3.gif[/img]

We get it, Gatlin' is a hard game - that's intended, not a bug. However, our Chief Balance Officer (me) and Head Intern (also me) have been bickering back and forth for nearly three years now about making the game easier.

Long story short, the Head Intern decked the CBO and stole his computer. We have Easy Mode now.

[u]While Easy Mode is enabled:[/u]
[list]
[*] Blot can take [b]two[/b] additional hits before dying horribly. That's right, his suffering is prolonged and even worse - you horrible, horrible, person.
[*] Boss achievements cannot be earned
[/list]

[h2]A new level modifier - Tumbleweed![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31717521/0707710b556c725e2a24e1862b61c498f9eb6d09.gif[/img]
It's goofy, it's silly - it's... actually quite difficult. Pair this with Easy Mode for a unique experience.

[h2]Entirely Organic Achievements![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31717521/69c02c404182a9a92eaa044123b3d62654d7f217.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31717521/e1b77ec3496f9b0dcd4501ea738cf5410078512f.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31717521/5dabaf20dac26509e248aa78b1ddbed2939922e0.png[/img]
Continuing the streak of more achievements, here ya go - three new ones. Something about a vacuum, a boss-related redacted one, and... WHAT!? [b]BLOT WITH A FACE!?! WHAT SORT OF HERESY IS THIS!? SOMEBODY CALL THE CBO[/b] - [i]oh wait...[/i]


[h1]Update Log[/h1]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Added "Easy Mode"[/b]
[*] [b]Added three new achievements ("Suck It Up, Buttercup", "Why?", "But Why Though?")[/b]
[*] [b]Added a new level modifier ("Tumbleweed")[/b]
[*] [b]Hovering over a toggle in the settings menu now displays a tip about what it does[/b]
[*] [b]Added death FX for Blot[/b]
[*] Added impact VFX for touching spikes
[*] Added splash VFX for falling into or shooting a liquid
[*] Added SFX to the pause/settings menu
[*] The screen now shakes whenever Blot dies or is hurt (only occurs when the "Screen Shake" setting is enabled)
[*] Added a new stat to the Lobby's leaderboard ("Easy Mode Hits Taken")
[*] Unhid the "Dumb Ways to Die" achievement on Steam
[*] Reworded the tutorial's hint about pausing to indicate that pressing "ESC/Start/Etc." also shows settings
[*] Adjusted Level 15 to match the changes brought to the "Intro" map in the 1.0.5 patch
[/list]
[h2]Fixes + Performance[/h2]
[list]
[*] The "Timed" level modifier now displays the initial amount of time given instead of starting one second later
[*] The "Level Modifiers" button in the lobby now properly displays a modifier's name instead of the variable name
[*] Settings now additionally save when closing the pause menu instead of solely when the game is closed
[*] The "Dumb Ways to Die" achievement can no longer be earned by having an enemy walk over a landmine
[*] Landmines can no longer visually be defused
[*] Fixed the picture frame's hitbox in all boss fights
[*] Fixed the range of the lighting of the lava in Level 6
[*] Fixed the z-layer of Apprencii's easel's text in Level 18
[*] Splash SFX are now played locally instead of globally
[*] Explosion SFX are now played locally instead of globally
[*] Polished the collision hitboxes of Blot's corpse
[*] Moved bullethole décor to the proper z-layer to prevent weird clipping
[*] Optimized the code for level modifiers
[*] Optimized the code for the pause/settings menu
[/list]

notes.title: Gatlin' - The Promised Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31717521/980a3952c2a76f7cdea7413bdaa2a77642412111.png[/img]
[h1]Gatlin' - The Promised Update (V1.0.4)[/h1]
[i]We promised to leave early access by 2021 at the latest. Guess what, it's 2020? We're leaving early access. DEVELOPMENTAL HELL? NEVER HEARD OF IT![/i]

[h2]Highlights:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]PROMISED[/b] graphical polishing! Nearly all sprites are enhanced. Now that's what I call jpeg!

[*] [b]BOUNTIFUL[/b] bug fixes! That's right, if you complain about a bug, we'll fix it!

[*] [b]PLENTIFUL[/b] new OST! Thank [url=https://soundcloud.com/cadence-hira]DJIVVI (aka Cadence Hira)[/url] or else.
[/list]

[h2]Three new achievements![/h2]

[list]
[*] Dumb Ways to Die
[*] Photo Finish
[*] Ramblin' Man

[list]
[*] Almost all of the game's sprites/terrain overhauled graphically

[*] The current level name is displayed in the pause menu

[*] Entering a level now has a transition

[*] Performance increased drastically in all levels where Blot has his gun

[*] Graphic priority changed from "Very Low" to "Medium" by default

[*] Default FOV changed from 0 to 6

[*] FOV is now on a scale from 0 to 12 instead of -4 to 6

[*] All levels polished to allow for increased FOV

[*] A toggling option to zoom the camera has been added to the alt-fire button

[*] An option to toggle this new zooming feature has been added to the settings menu

[*] Gatlin' now fully supports the Steam Controller!

[*] Gatlin' now supports Xbox, Playstation, and Nintendo Switch controllers!

[*] Removed unused target portals from the lobby

[*] Opening cutscene conga line movement made less awkward

[*] Opening cutscene tweaked to allude to more of the story

[*] Various world tweaks from the opening cutscene replicated to Level 15

[*] The NPCs in the intro cutscene now have an idle animation

[*] Cutscene Blot can now reset using the reset keybind (M) while walking

[*] All liquids start their flow at the same time

[*] Dying in a liquid now has a sound effect

[*] David now flashes when damaged

[*] Several annoying ceiling structures removed on Level 10

[*] Credits takes damage when its letters fall into the ink

[*] The Protector now flashes when damaged

[*] World 4's background has been made less trippy

[*] Camera flash made less bright

[*] You can no longer pause on the victory screen

[*] Tut corpses now properly block bullets (hitbox fixed)

[*] Blot's minigun no longer clips through the secret rock tunnel in the tutorial

[*] Blot's corpse's hands no longer clip through liquids

[*] Blot's running cloud in the opening cutscene no longer clips over the ground

[*] Clouds no longer clip through levels

[*] David's light rays now appear behind his head

[*] Apprencii's paintbrushes no longer clip through his picture frame

[*] Scribbles no longer render behind Apprencii

[*] Bridge pieces in Level 15 have been modified to prevent visual clipping

[*] Visual ground clipping areas in Level 15 and Level 16 have been fixed

[h2]Future Plans[/h2]

notes.title: Gatlin' - The Annual Big Comprehensive Holiday Update #1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31717521/67e2100c19dd80b5ef465d6deefd4d93940a4aa4.png[/img]
[h1]Gatlin' - The Annual Big Comprehensive Holiday Update #1 (1.0.2)[/h1]
[i]Introducing the first-ever "The Annual Big Comprehensive Holiday Update." We're starting off relatively small this year, but we hope to make this a big thing for Gatlin' in the future once/if we pick up more of a community.[/i]

[h2]Highlights:[/h2][list]
[*] [b]OST is finally here! Thank [url=https://soundcloud.com/cadence-hira]DJIVVI (aka Cadence Hira)[/url] for joining Gatlin' as the composer![/b] Some levels still have placeholder music, but over time we plan on covering all the bases!

[*] [b]New world! Introducing "Art's Rejects."[/b] These levels are various polished concepts that were taken out of story mode for being on the crueler side. 

[*] [b]New boss! Meet "Credits."[/b] Credits is a physics-based boss battle that ideally makes giving proper credits not annoying! Well, not annoying in the traditional sense.

[*] [b]New boss! Meet "Damn."[/b] Damn is a unique boss fight. It resides at the end of Art's Rejects. We'll leave it at that.

[*] The Steam assets for Gatlin' have been overhauled to seem slightly less crummy!
[/list]

[h2]Eight new achievements![/h2][list]
[*] Accredited Actor
[*] Addendum
[*] Barren Field
[*] God of Rejects
[*] Midknight Crisis
[*] Right to Privacy
[*] Symphonic
[*] Target Practice
[/list]

[h2]Changes:[/h2][list]
[*]We heard you. We get it. The annoying music system was too annoying. [b]Music now continues playing where it left off after death.[/b]

[*][b]Suction projectile speed has been increased from 35 units to 45 units[/b]

[*][b]There is now a friend in Level One[/b]

[*]The lobby has been modified to add the entrance to Credits

[*]The bridge now actually has pieces fall in the starting cutscene

[*]The tutorial has been modified to ensure the restart hint consistently appears

[*]Liquid (ink, water, lava) hitboxes have been made more precise

[*]Rock clattering sounds are no longer global, they are now affected by distance

[*]Antique marching sounds are no longer global, they are now affected by distance

[*]David now has a dialog cue to indicate that enemies take varying damage from different ammo types

[*]Apprencii's arena no longer has walls at the edge of the island

[*]The Beholder now flashes red when you shoot it

[*]The Beholder now shoots a tear each time it takes damage after its first phase
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2][list]
[*] In-game wall hints have been remade with a higher resolution

[*]Explosives no longer trigger the fuse noise more than once when activated

[*]The restart hint now consistently drops in the tutorial

[*]The main story continue system now only saves levels from the main story

[*]Enemies that are vulnerable to spikes no longer die from touching the side of spikes

[*]Enemies that are vulnerable to boulders now die from moving boulders

[*]Scribbles no longer visually overlap the map

[*]Scribbles now properly find the player in small rooms and hallways

[*]The Protector no longer uses its stardust ability during its first phase

[*]Blot will no longer awkwardly float dead on Apprencii's water

[*]The frame hitbox (aka the border) in boss fights has been made more accurate
[/list]
